arxiv-2012-08687.title: StrokeGAN: Reducing Mode Collapse in Chinese Font Generation via Stroke Encoding
arxiv-2012-08687.creator: Jinshan Zeng, Qi Chen, Yunxin Liu, Mingwen Wang, Yuan Yao
arxiv-2012-08687.description: Abstract The generation of stylish Chinese fonts is an important problem involved in many applications. Most of existing generation methods are based on the deep generative models, particularly, the generative adversarial networks (GAN) based models. However, these deep generative models may suffer from the mode collapse issue, which significantly degrades the diversity and quality of generated results.

arxiv-2207-02270.title: Measurement of the top quark pole mass using \ttbar ​ +jet \ttbar\text{+jet} events in the dilepton final state in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2207-02270.description: Abstract A measurement of the top quark pole mass m \PQt pole m_{\PQt}^{\text{pole}} in events where a top quark-antiquark pair ( \ttbar ) is produced in association with at least one additional jet ( \ttbar ​ +jet \ttbar\text{+jet} ) is presented.

arxiv-2304-09044.title: Construction of coarse-grained molecular dynamics with many-body non-Markovian memory
arxiv-2304-09044.creator: Liyao Lyu, Huan Lei
arxiv-2304-09044.description: Abstract We introduce a machine-learning-based coarse-grained molecular dynamics (CGMD) model that faithfully retains the many-body nature of the inter-molecular dissipative interactions. Unlike the common empirical CG models, the present model is constructed based on the Mori-Zwanzig formalism and naturally inherits the heterogeneous state-dependent memory term rather than matching the mean-field metrics such as the velocity auto-correlation function.

arxiv-2306-07329.title: Symplectic cuts and open/closed strings I
arxiv-2306-07329.creator: Luca Cassia
arxiv-2306-07329.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Luca Cassia. This paper introduces a concrete relation between genus zero closed Gromov–Witten invariants of Calabi–Yau threefolds and genus zero open Gromov–Witten invariants of a Lagrangian A A -brane in the same threefold. Symplectic cutting is a natural operation that decomposes a symplectic manifold ( X , ω ) (X,\omega) with a Hamiltonian U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) action into two pieces glued along an invariant divisor.

arxiv-2410-04890.title: Mechanisms of electrostatic interactions between two charged dielectric spheres inside a polarizable medium: An effective-dipole analysis
arxiv-2410-04890.creator: Yanyu Duan, Zecheng Gan, Ho-Kei Chan
arxiv-2410-04890.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yanyu Duan, Zecheng Gan, Ho-Kei Chan. The mechanisms of electrostatic interactions between two charged dielectric spheres inside a polarizable medium have been investigated, in terms of hypothetical effective dipoles that depict how the positive and negative charge in each particle are separated.

arxiv-2504-21314.title: Capturing Conditional Dependence via Auto-regressive Diffusion Models
arxiv-2504-21314.creator: Xunpeng Huang, Yujin Han, Difan Zou, Yian Ma, Tong Zhang
arxiv-2504-21314.description: Abstract Diffusion models have demonstrated appealing performance in both image and video generation. However, many works discover that they struggle to capture important, high-level relationships that are present in the real world. For example, they fail to learn physical laws from data, and even fail to understand that the objects in the world exist in a stable fashion.

arxiv-2510-22338.title: Operationalizing Large Language Models with Design-Aware Contexts for Code Comment Generation Conference: International Conference on Software Engineering; April 12–18, 2026; Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
arxiv-2510-22338.creator: Aritra Mitra, Srijoni Majumdar, Anamitra Mukhopadhyay, Partha Pratim Das, Paul D Clough, Partha Pratim Chakrabarti
arxiv-2510-22338.description: Abstract . Comments are very useful to the flow of code development. With the increasing commonality of code, novice coders have been creating a significant amount of codebases. Due to lack of commenting standards, their comments are often useless, and increase the time taken to further maintain codes.

arxiv-2511-13595.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Nonlinear Output Regulation
arxiv-2511-13595.creator: Sebastiano Mengozzi, Giovanni B. Esposito, Michelangelo Bin, Andrea Acquaviva, Andrea Bartolini, Lorenzo Marconi
arxiv-2511-13595.description: Abstract This work addresses the full-information output regulation problem for nonlinear systems, assuming the states of both the plant and the exosystem are known. In this setting, perfect tracking or rejection is achieved by constructing a zero-regulation-error manifold π ⁡ ( w ) \pi(w) and a feedforward input c ⁡ ( w ) c(w) that render such manifold invariant.

pmc-11505412.title: A Stepwise Diagnostic Stewardship Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Urine Cultures, Asymptomatic Bacteriuria, and CAUTI Rate
pmc-11505412.creator: Mina Said, Vanessa Kung, Abigail Beck, Deanna Buehrle, Kristin Nagaro, Graham Snyder, Elise Martin
pmc-11505412.description: Background: Clinically non-indicated asymptomatic bacteriuria (ASB) identification precipitates higher reported catheter-associated urinary tract infection (CAUTI) rates and urinary tract infection (UTI)-directed antimicrobial overuse. Published diagnostic stewardship interventions to reduce ASB were mostly tested individually and heterogeneously; hence the optimal bundle approach is yet to be defined.

pmc-11506365.title: An Early Increase in IL-10 and TNF-α Levels Following Atezolizumab Plus Bevacizumab Treatment Predicts Survival in Advanced Hepatocellular Carcinoma Patients: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-11506365.creator: Soon Kyu Lee, Soon Woo Nam, Ji Won Han, Jung Hyun Kwon, Manfred Ogris
pmc-11506365.description: Simple SummaryDue to a shortage of reliable biomarkers for predicting outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) following treatment with atezolizumab plus bevacizumab (Ate/Bev), we assessed the impact of early changes in cytokine levels on the clinical outcomes of advanced HCC patients.

pmc-11710496.title: Investigating the microvascular dysfunction in the Frontotemporal Dementia using a progranulin‐deficient mice model
pmc-11710496.creator: Supriya Chakraborty, Sofia Franciosa, Oliver Bracko
pmc-11710496.description: BackgroundDespite being the second most common form of dementia, vascular contributions of Frontotemporal Dementia are understudied. Recent data from patients and preliminary experiments have indicated that in progranulin‐deficient mice, an increased number of cortical capillaries are stalled, and cerebral blood flow is reduced. Here, we examined the underlying mechanism contributing to microvascular dysfunction in FTD.

pmc-11772166.title: Global, regional and national burden of pancreatic cancer and its attributable risk factors from 2019 to 2021, with projection to 2044
pmc-11772166.creator: Xiao Li, Yi Zhang, Zeyi Yan, Wenkai Jiang, Shaozhen Rui
pmc-11772166.description: BackgroundTo estimate the global burden of pancreatic cancer in 2019 and 2021 including incidence, mortality, and disability-adjusted-life-years (DALYs).MethodsData on pancreatic cancer incidence, mortality and DALYs were downloaded from the Global Health Data Exchange. The 95% uncertainty intervals (UIs) were reported for annual numbers and rates (per 100,000 populations).

pmc-12449067.title: Communicative participation of school-aged children with cochlear implants: parental perceptions
pmc-12449067.creator: Louise Duchesne, Marie-Pier Gingras, Maude Gagnon
pmc-12449067.description: This qualitative study aimed to explore parents’ perceptions regarding the communication of their school-aged child with cochlear implants (CIs) in various social contexts. To this end, the construct of “communicative participation” (World Health Organization (2001), International Classification of Functioning, Disability, and Health, https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/international-classification-of-functioning-disability-and-health) was broadly applied to the population of children with CIs.

pmc-13202681.title: Smartphone-based point-of-care analyzer for rapid hemoglobin and potassium monitoring in end-stage renal disease and perioperative renal transplantation patients
pmc-13202681.creator: Yiling Fang, Shengquan Wu, Ze Wu, Yibin Wang, Qiangqiang Fu, Yun Miao
pmc-13202681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study aimed to develop a smartphone-based analyzer capable of detecting hemoglobin and potassium levels, with clinical validation using a perioperative renal transplant cohort. We implemented azide-methemoglobin and potassium-tetraphenylborate reactions to detect hemoglobin and potassium levels respectively. A smartphone-based system using ambient light sensors and a Phyphox application was used to measure the light intensity changes, with concentrations calculated via calibration curves.

pmc-13384561.title: GPER, 8-isoprostaglandin, and tau protein as potential biomarkers in supraventricular tachycardia: An observational study
pmc-13384561.creator: Ünal Öztürk, Nuray Üremiş, Ergül Belge Kurutaş
pmc-13384561.description: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) is a common arrhythmic disorder characterized by abnormal electrical impulses arising from supraventricular tissues, most commonly the atria or atrioventricular node. This study aimed to investigate the association between G protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER) levels and biomarkers of oxidative stress and neurodegeneration in the pathophysiology of SVT.

pmc-13459805.title: ChronoSort: Revealing Hidden Dynamics in AlphaFold3 Structure Predictions
pmc-13459805.creator: Matthew J Argyle, William P Heaps, Corbyn Kubalek, Spencer S Gardiner, Bradley C Bundy, Dennis Della Corte
pmc-13459805.description: Protein function emerges from dynamic conformational changes, yet structure prediction methods provide only static snapshots. While AlphaFold3 (AF3) predicts protein structures, the potential for extracting dynamic information from its ensemble predictions has remained underexplored. Here, we demonstrate that AF3 structural ensembles contain substantial dynamic information that correlates remarkably well with molecular dynamics simulations (MD).
